lastCompletedStory.title: Orchestrator boot surfaces the ship-stalled marker

nextStoryContext: US-003 (last story in this PRD, CAM-182) is done: added boot step 6 to the 'Boot context' section of both subagent-orchestrator.md copies (templates/agents/ is source of truth, .claude/agents/ is the runtime mirror; both were byte-identical before and after this edit, confirmed via diff) instructing the orchestrator to read .claude/.cam-ship-stalled.json at boot and, when present, surface prNumber/reason/prUrl as an opening blocker line before the 'What would you like to do?' prompt (falls back to 'no PR url recorded' when prUrl is null). Explicitly documented that the orchestrator must NOT delete the marker at boot (read-only surface; removal is owned by the sidecar's MERGED-terminal consume path in updateShipStalledMarker, src/commands/sidecar.ts, from US-002). Regenerated src/vendor/_generated.ts via bun run embed-vendor (embed-vendor:check now clean). All 3 stories in this PRD (US-001 auto-recover BEHIND via gh pr update-branch, US-002 durable stalled-escalation event+marker, US-003 this orchestrator boot-surface step) now have passes:true -- the PRD is functionally complete pending review/ship. No open questions or deferred work.
